isEnum: {property} must be a valid enum value
isIn: {property} must be one of the allowed values
isDateString: {property} must be a valid ISO date string
minLength: {property} is shorter than the minimum length
maxLength: {property} is longer than the maximum length
min: {property} must not be less than the minimum
max: {property} must not be greater than the maximum
money: {property} must be a non-negative decimal string with up to 10 digits and 2 decimal places
isDefined: {property} should not be null or undefined
